label: Rival: some first being is a component of something other than itself (world-soul)
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by the positions reported in ST I q.3 a.8 (God as the soul of the world, as the formal principle of all things, or as prime matter) and by pantheist and panentheist accounts: some being to which nothing other is simply prior is a component of something other than itself. The replacement account is that being a constituent does not subordinate: the whole depends on the first principle that informs it. Strictly stronger than the negation of STMT-NO-COMPONENT-IS-FIRST-BEING, which would allow a first being that is a component only of itself. It does not say the first being is itself composite.
